text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ and I are walking past
the train
station when she suddenly
remembers something
and stops in her
tracks.
By the way, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that cafe we tried
going to the
other day?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm still baffled as to why it was
closed so
early. Do you mind if we go
back and check it
out?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And with that request, we make our way
to the
cafe together.

It closes at 8 p.m., so it should still be
open...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We're almost at the cafe when we see
someone
who appears to be the owner
pulling down the
shutters.
It seems like it. I wonder why. I'll go ask.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I follow her as she approaches the
owner.

Excuse me. Have your store hours
changed
recently? I thought you were
supposed to be
open for a while yet.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Terribly sorry about that, but yes, we've
been
closing a little early lately.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
It just doesn't make sense to stay open
when we
get no customers.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text: You don't?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No... Not since that new place down the
street run
by some famous celebrity
barista opened up.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text: Business dried up as soon as that place started. Honestly, we might have to close up shop permanently soon.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text: That can't be...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's no question as to what cafe that
must be.
No doubt, it's the one I visited
with Biwa
Hayahide the other day.

Up until recently, we managed to scrape
by
somehow.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
We've come up with seasonal menu
items and
listened to the requests of our
regulars...
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
But no matter what we do, it's not
enough to
compete against a famous
barista.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
It makes sense. When someone like that,
with
both skills and fame, opens a shop
down the
street, there's not much a
small cafe like us can
do.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's expression clouds as
she mulls
over the matter.
I understand how you feel. However...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What I love most about your cafe is how
cozy its
atmosphere is and what a
wonderful person you
are.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And those things are all a result of how
much
effort you've put into making your
customers
happy.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You've accomplished so much already.
Why don't
you try just a little harder and
see what comes of
it?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her impassioned speech is inspiring. I
feel as
though it's enough to fire anyone
up. However...

Thank you. Your kind words mean a
great deal to
me.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
But running a business isn't easy.
Sometimes, you
just have to cut your
losses.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Бива Хаяхидэ's
encouragement
isn't enough to spur the
owner into further action.

I suppose life is difficult no matter what
one
pursues.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I only wish there was something I could
do to
help...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Pursuing a dream is tough. She knows
that better
than anyone.
choice_data_list:
If only the cafe could do something to set it
apart...
Maybe we can help promote the cafe.

text_block_list.text: Set it apart... Yes, that's it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I go there all the time! I would know
better than
anyone how it can best stand
out!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
This information might be just what we
need to
change the owner's mind!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me come up with
something I
can do!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I guess, realistically speaking, that's
about all we
can do.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But simply promoting the cafe probably
won't
yield any significant results...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: If only we had something to work with...

text_block_list.text:
But of course! If there's nothing to work
with yet,
we can start from scratch and
try to catch
people's attention with a
new idea!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll start putting together everything we
need
once I get back!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Let me know if I can help.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I'm going to make
sure that
cafe stays in business!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
With that strong declaration, it's clear
that Biwa
Hayahide is filled with
determination.

I have high hopes that Бива Хаяхидэ
can get
through to the owner as we walk
home together.
